title: Per-turn LLM scoring for ranker
wanted_capability: Learned/model-based ranking beyond the fixed heuristic multiplier. Designated instrument (2026-06-12 routing-design rewrite, Layer 3): a cross-encoder rerank stage (voyage rerank-2.5-lite) over the RRF-fused top-k — cheaper and better calibrated than per-turn LLM scoring, A/B-measurable via the shipped MRR/recall@k metrics substrate. Per-turn LLM scoring remains the aspirational fallback only if the cross-encoder underperforms on eval.
notes: 2026-06-12: re-pointed at rerank-2.5-lite cross-encoder stage per design/corpus/agentic-corpus/multimodal-embedding-routing.md Layer 3 / migration Phase 4.
